svg.title: Exit codes in practice
svg.desc: Exit: 0, Meaning: Done, Retry?: , Typical handling: Use stdout; Exit: 2, Meaning: Deadline, cancellation, or script error, Retry?: Check state first, Typical handling: Read stderr; already-dispatched JavaScript and side effects may continue; Exit: 3, Meaning: Signed out, Retry?: No, Typical handling: Tell the person to run umbra sign-in, then skip this run; Exit: 4, Meaning: The page or download failed to load, Retry?: Yes, later, Typical handling: Network down, site down, or a bad host name; Exit: 5, Meaning: HTTP error status, Retry?: Rarely, Typical handling: stderr is HTTP <status>. fetch still prints the body, which often explains the error; Exit: 64, Meaning: Usage error, Retry?: No, Typical handling: A bug in the caller; Exit: 78, Meaning: sites.json can't be parsed, Retry?: No, Typical handling: Fix the file
